intro: Each of you builds a car that turns into a robot, then you fight waves of enemy bots together. Fight as a robot; change back into a car to get away, to chase, or to ram.
inspiredBy: Robots in disguise go back to the transforming toys and cartoons of the 1980s. Shift Bots is our own take, with our own bots, cars and world.
goal: Survive as many waves as you can. If everyone on your team is down at once, it's over.
howToPlay: Join with your phone. In the lobby, choose the battleground and how hard it is, then press {bolt} to build your bots.

In the garage, ▲▼ picks a row and ◀▶ changes it: the body (each car becomes a different robot), the paint and its shade, the trim colour, the finish, your weapon and your special. Press {leaf} to see it change.
Press {bolt} when you're happy. The fight starts when everyone's ready.
As a robot: move with the stick, hold {bolt} to shoot (it aims at the nearest enemy the way you're facing), {drop} to punch, {star} for your special and {l1} to dodge.

Press {leaf} to change into a car: much faster, and you can ram. It drives like the racing games: the stick left and right steers, up is the gas, and pulled back it brakes, then reverses. Hold {bolt} to boost. Press {leaf} again to stand back up; change while you're moving and you land with a slam.
Knocked down? A friend who stands beside you for a few seconds gets you back up. Between waves, spend the scrap you picked up on your phone.
steering: Move with the stick on your phone (or WASD / the arrow keys)
tips: Changing takes a moment, and you can't fight while it happens. You take less damage while you change, though.
Hurt? Drive off as a car: your armour mends while you're out of the fight.
Heavy bodies take more punishment; light ones are quicker and harder to hit.
Between waves, spend scrap on armour, damage, speed or a quicker special. Each step costs more than the last.
Every fifth wave brings the Hauler. Keep moving: it stamps the ground when you're close.
Each battleground fights differently: cover everywhere in the quarry, open sand in the desert, tight streets in the city, and in the snow your car slides, so turn early.
Every fight earns stars, and more for beating your best wave. Spend them on new finishes in the shop on your phone.
